description: Certified true copy of your Birth Certificate issued by the Philippine Statistics Authority.

displayName: Certified True Copy of Baptismal Certificate
description: Must be a recently issued copy from your baptism parish with the specific annotation for marriage purposes.

displayName: Certified True Copy of Confirmation Certificate
description: Must be a recently issued copy from your confirmation parish with the specific annotation for marriage purposes.
Certificate of No Marriage Record issued by the PSA (for Filipinos only) confirming no prior legal marriage exists.

displayName: Pre-Cana Seminar or Pre-Nuptial Counseling Certificate
description: Certificate of Attendance/Completion of a Pre-Cana Seminar or Pre-Nuptial Counseling. Confirm with the church if they accept certificates issued by CEFAM or Discovery Weekend; otherwise schedule and complete the Pre-Cana seminar required by the wedding parish.
Formal interview to be scheduled and conducted with the church where you are to marry.

displayName: Marriage Banns and Permission (with 2x2 ID Picture)
description: Bring to the respective parishes of the couple to be posted for three (3) consecutive Sundays.
Permission from the Parish Priest if marrying outside your parish.

displayName: Submit Reply Notice of Marriage Banns
description: Submit the reply notice of marriage banns back to the wedding church after posting at your home parishes.
Certificate of authority to solemnize marriage (CRASM) and celebret of guest priest, applicable if you will have your own priest.
Submit church forms and permits required by the wedding parish.
Final list of principal sponsors, including the full address of two of your principal sponsors.
Carefully review the draft marriage certificate for spelling, names, birthdates, and other details before the ceremony.
For foreigners, non-Catholics, or divorcees: inquire or visit at the Chancery Office regarding additional clearances.

groom.notes: Set to required if this applies to the groom.

bride.notes: Set to required if this applies to the bride.

description: For mixed or previous marriage cases: confirm applicable requirements with the Archdiocese.

displayName: PSA Civil Marriage and Annulment or Report of Marriage

bride.notes: Set to required if previously civilly married.

displayName: Certificate of Freedom to Marry or Affidavit of Free Status
description: For foreigners: Certificate of Freedom to Marry from the parish of present residence abroad for six months or more immediately prior to the wedding, or Affidavit of Free Status to Marry.

bride.notes: Set to required only if the bride is a foreign national.

description: For foreigners: Certificate of Free Status to Marry / Legal Capacity from the Embassy of the country of origin.
